snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

sources.name: BMC Genomics research article guidelines (read in a browser)
BMC Genomics submission guidelines (read in a browser)

requirements.rule: Abstract at most 350 words, no references
requirements.quote: The Abstract should not exceed 350 words.

requirements.rule: Abstract with separate sections: Background, Results, Conclusions
requirements.quote: The abstract must include the following separate sections:

requirements.rule: Three to ten keywords
requirements.quote: Three to ten keywords representing the main content of the article.

requirements.rule: Background, Methods, Results, Discussion, Conclusions
requirements.quote: The information below details the section headings that you should include in your manuscript

requirements.rule: A 'Declarations' section with all its subheadings ('Not applicable' where relevant)
requirements.quote: Please note that your manuscript must include a 'Declarations' section including all of the subheadings

requirements.rule: Declarations: Ethics approval and consent to participate
requirements.quote: All manuscripts must contain the following sections under the heading 'Declarations':

requirements.rule: Declarations: Availability of data and materials
requirements.quote: All manuscripts must include an ‘Availability of data and materials’ statement.

requirements.rule: Declarations: Competing interests
requirements.quote: All financial and non-financial competing interests must be declared in this section.

requirements.rule: Declarations: Funding
requirements.quote: All sources of funding for the research reported should be declared.

requirements.rule: Declarations: Authors' contributions, using initials
requirements.quote: The individual contributions of authors to the manuscript should be specified in this section.

requirements.rule: Declarations: Acknowledgements (or 'Not applicable')
requirements.quote: If you do not have anyone to acknowledge, please write "Not applicable" in this section.

requirements.rule: Declarations: Consent for publication
requirements.quote: Consent for publication

requirements.rule: Double line spacing
requirements.quote: Use double-line spacing

requirements.rule: Line numbers
requirements.quote: Include line and page numbering

requirements.rule: Page numbers
requirements.quote: Include line and page numbering

requirements.rule: Numbered citations in square brackets (Vancouver style), per the journal's CSL style
requirements.quote: Examples of the Vancouver reference style are shown below.

requirements.rule: Figure files at most 10 MB, about 300 dpi at final size (85 mm or 170 mm wide); TIFF with LZW
requirements.quote: Individual figure files should not exceed 10 MB.

requirements.rule: Figure titles (max 15 words) and legends (max 300 words) in the manuscript, not in the image
requirements.quote: Figure titles (max 15 words) and legends (max 300 words) should be provided in the main manuscript, not in the graphic file.

requirements.rule: Table titles (max 15 words) above, legends below; no colour or shading
requirements.quote: Table titles (max 15 words) should be included above the table, and legends (max 300 words) should be included underneath the table.

requirements.rule: Supplementary files are called "Additional file 1" and so on, each at most 20 MB, listed in a separate section
requirements.quote: Additional files should be named "Additional file 1" and so on

requirements.rule: No page breaks
requirements.quote: Do not use page breaks in your manuscript

requirements.rule: Genomics data deposited in a community-endorsed public repository
requirements.quote: submission to a community-endorsed, public repository is mandatory.

requirements.rule: Use of a large language model documented in Methods
requirements.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section

requirements.rule: Cover letter: why BMC Genomics, policy issues, competing interests, all authors approved, not published elsewhere
requirements.quote: An explanation of why your manuscript should be published in BMC Genomics
